value.rationale: The Fano incidence graph is a canonical cubic girth-six cage; its complete distance-two chromatic polynomial is a natural full polynomial invariant, and its optima-to-one-extra-colour reconfiguration gives a nontrivial exact structural benchmark for local recolouring and colour-sampling on 70 million states. This includes precise strata of 1008 extendible and 588 unextendible size-six nonincidence matchings and all cross/within-state edge counts, none implied by the generic connectivity theorem. The finite scope and absence of a universal theorem are explicitly acknowledged.
